current_leader.name: Cloud support-plan right-sizing engine
current_leader.state_transition: monthly cloud spend + provider-independent operational/incident telemetry -> recompute current support-tier cost and required SLA/features -> compare cheaper eligible tiers -> recommend KEEP/DOWNGRADE/UPGRADE -> verify support-fee delta
current_leader.why_survived: Read-only, deterministic fee delta, recurring cross-cloud support-plan pricing, and no exact continuous telemetry-aware cross-cloud support-tier optimizer established in prior research.
current_leader.closest_threat: First-party calculators/change workflows and broad FinOps/MSP platforms.
current_leader.smallest_intervention: Read billing forecast, current support tier, workload criticality/SLOs and incident history; recommend cheapest sufficient tier with savings and capability tradeoff; no plan-change execution.
current_leader.monetization: Small accepted-change fee, low recurring monitoring fee, or capped share of verified support-fee savings.
current_leader.biggest_unresolved_risk: The correct tier may be mostly static/tail-risk-driven, collapsing value into an annual review.
current_leader.next_research_test: Quantify real support-tier overprovisioning/change frequency and search exact FinOps/MSP support-plan optimization; reject if annual review captures most value.

recent_cross_family_findings: Card authorization integrity-fee prevention failed the broad Gate-8 test: IBM Sterling OMS already has configurable automatic authorization reversal for unfulfilled/expired/excess authorizations and Adyen's Salesforce OMS integration handles reversal when orders cannot be fulfilled.
Visa/Mastercard integrity fees remain real and deterministic, but the remaining scheme-deadline overlay is too narrow to retain the prior 49/60 score without strong incidence evidence.
Merchant card-network behavior-fee sentinel demoted to 45 because Stripe already prevents some retry penalties and specialist fee-intelligence vendors cover surrounding scheme-fee optimization.
Cloud support-plan right-sizing returns to leader at 46/60 but still faces recurrence and FinOps/MSP absorption tests.
New rule: search OMS/business-system automation, not only PSP-native features, before declaring payment-lifecycle whitespace.
